landslide.title: Landslide: route closed
landslide.body: A landslide has been reported on {segment}. Do not continue on this path.
landslide.action: Turn back to the safe area

closed_trail.title: Trail closed
closed_trail.body: This part of the trail ({segment}) is closed for your safety.

restricted.title: Restricted area
restricted.body: You are near a restricted area ({segment}). Entry is not allowed without a permit.

wildlife_core.title: Wildlife zone
wildlife_core.body: You are near a core wildlife area ({segment}). Animals may be close.
wildlife_core.action: Leave quietly the way you came

flood.title: Flood risk
flood.body: Water levels are rising near {segment}. Stay away from the river bank.

crowd.title: Dense crowd
crowd.body: The crowd near {segment} is very dense. Pushing can cause injuries.
crowd.action: Move slowly to an open area

crowd_inside: Dense crowd here. Move slowly toward the open area.
crowd_ahead: Heavy crowd ahead. Wait about {wait} minutes or take {alt}.

check.check_landslide: Landslide reported near you. Are you safe?
check.check_generic: An emergency was reported near you. Are you safe?

message_to_group: Help has been informed. Stay where you are if it is safe, and keep your phone on.

briefing: Share the family link before you start.
Stay on the marked route and turn back if a warning appears.
Carry water, a warm layer and a charged phone.

symptoms: Headache that does not go away
do_now: Go down if symptoms get worse
Get help at the nearest medical post

lost: Stop and stay where you are
Open the map and find the route line
Walk back only along a path you know
Send SOS if you cannot find the route
injured: Move to a safe spot if you can
Do not give medicines you are not sure about
blocked: Turn back to the last shelter
Answer the safety check when asked
crowd: Keep your arms in front of your chest

phrases.landslide: The path is blocked by a landslide.
phrases.which_way: Which way is the safe path?
